title: Tutorials
summary: Each screen has a guided tour of its features that highlights each element and uses the same text as this manual.
usage: The tour opens by itself the first time you visit a screen. To see it again, use the help button (?) in the side menu, Tutorial for this screen in Ctrl+K, or Settings › App › Tutorials, where you can also turn off the automatic tours. Long steps come in parts: Next and the arrow keys move through them, Back returns, and the bars under the text show where you are.
